receipt.title: 13 Unreleased Videos I Thought Would Go Viral
receipt.description:
13 unreleased Zack D. Films videos, hand-picked from the vault. For the first time ever, animated full screen.

Check our sources 👉🏻 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1E0xayBrcv6wbd853CMCgjKMS0S9h_Q0h3_PQOb8NrTU/edit?tab=t.0

Join Our Free Patreon For Extra Content 👉🏻 patreon.com/zackdfilms

Credit to Randall Munroe and his book/research for inspiring and informing the steak segment of this video (07:53). Check out his channel 👉🏻  @xkcd_whatif
